english.title: Failing to comply with PAYE regs to give security / further security for payment of any amount
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been required by an officer of Revenue and Customs, failed to give security, or further security, for the payment of amounts for which you were accountable to HM Revenue and Customs in accordance with **(..SPECIFY THE REGULATIONS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section684(4A) of the Income Tax (Earnings and Pensions) Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
required by an officer of Revenue and Customs
failed to give security/further security for the payment of amounts to HMRC
in accordance with PAYE regulations

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
